applies_to: Turn P10.4 (or later) table-aware chunk design -- this Turn implements nothing

chunk_kinds.ATOMIC_TABLE_ROW: one table row, self-contained: row_header + all column values, no inherited context needed beyond the row itself
chunk_kinds.TABLE_ROW_WITH_HEADERS: one table row PLUS its column/period header row and any unit-declaring row, explicitly carried as provenance fields rather than relying on chunk adjacency
chunk_kinds.MULTI_ROW_CONTEXT: a bounded set of rows needed together for a calculation/comparison (per Stage 1-2's MULTI_ROW_CALCULATION/MULTI_COLUMN_COMPARISON tags), sharing one inherited_context_provenance block
chunk_kinds.TABLE_SUMMARY_CONTEXT: table_title/section_title only, for retrieval-time context injection without duplicating every row's content

invariants: ambiguous locator를 임의 해소하지 않는다 (fails closed to GOLD_LOCATOR_AMBIGUOUS)
Gold 내용을 청킹 규칙에 하드코딩하지 않는다
exclusions_pending_parser_recovery: 4 PARSE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED source(s) excluded from table-aware chunk scoring until parser recovery
